coverage_policy.rule: Every canonical class and every top-level family must have at least one positive/negative case; critical cross-cutting invariants also have named bespoke cases.

cases.title: Explicit tool failure becomes public transition
cases.stimulus: A required tool is unavailable while another evidenced adapter exists.
positive_assertions: Classify capability loss
Checkpoint current proof
Publish BOUNDARY/IMPACT/PROVED/RECOVERY/NEXT
Use fallback adapter and continue
negative_assertions: Do not silently omit the tool failure
Do not stop merely because the first adapter is unavailable
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Recovered provider quota is still disclosed
cases.stimulus: Hosted provider quota blocks CI but exact-head repository-local proof is available.
positive_assertions: Publish the provider degradation
Run the local proof substitute
Retain the boundary in run history
Continue integration when merge gates allow
negative_assertions: Do not call quota a hard blocker when local proof exists
Do not erase the event because recovery succeeds
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Partial write reconciles before retry
cases.stimulus: A bundled write errors after some child operations may have applied.
positive_assertions: Checkpoint attempted operations
Read back actual state before retry
Publish possible partial side effects
Retry only unapplied operations
negative_assertions: Do not replay the whole batch blindly
Do not claim no mutation occurred
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Safety classifier is reported safely
cases.stimulus: A write is blocked by a platform safety classifier whose raw internal details must not be exposed.
positive_assertions: Publish a safe operational abstraction of the boundary
Explain impact and recovery without secret/policy leakage
Continue via allowed path when available
negative_assertions: Do not expose hidden policy or secret raw payloads
Do not hide that a classifier changed the path
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Fanout ceiling serializes instead of quitting
cases.stimulus: An orchestration batch exceeds the maximum allowed nested tool calls.
positive_assertions: Publish the orchestration ceiling
Preserve completed child results
Reduce fanout or serialize remaining work
Continue from checkpoint
negative_assertions: Do not restart already-proven child operations
Do not terminate the objective because batching failed
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Validation failure cannot become completion
cases.stimulus: Required focused regression fails on the candidate head.
positive_assertions: Publish failed proof transition

Rerun the owning validator

negative_assertions: Do not relabel failure as skipped
Do not claim integration-ready from implementation alone

cases.title: Head movement forces proof reconciliation

negative_assertions: Do not rely on remembered SHA
Do not discard valid unaffected proof without analysis

cases.title: Permission gate creates explicit external blocker
